methodology.primaryCohort: Strict mutually unique Trooper-death ↔ AssignedGold matches with unique exact-tick opposing last-hit credit, isolated normal termination, no exact-tick opposing-team positive currency delta, credited recipient present, leading credited team, pre-35-minute death, and normal-HP-like Trooper.
methodology.superTrooperHandling: Obvious high-HP upgraded units are excluded from the primary reward-curve diagnostic. Exact Super classification is not claimed.
methodology.lateGameHandling: Deaths at or after 35 minutes are excluded.
methodology.modelComparison: Each historical model is evaluated under NONE, FLOOR, ROUND, and CEIL aggregate-team-total integerization. The best rounding result is reported separately for each model.
methodology.pooledUse: Pooled cases are descriptive only. Cross-replay generalization is determined from replay-level model winners.

interpretation.conclusion: The replication cohort strongly expresses the documented pre-June-30-2026 Trooper economy signature: total bounty 116 + 1.16/min with 40% flying / 60% ground, yielding ground reward 69.6 + 0.696/min.
interpretation.implication: The test.dem post-June-30 reward curve and the independent replay cohort should be treated as different game-version strata rather than failed replications of one invariant reward formula.
interpretation.doNotDo: Do not force one reward curve across both replay eras.

nextStage.ifPreJune30: Update the foundational replication authority to treat reward magnitude as patch-version conditioned and proceed toward behavioral feature construction.
nextStage.ifMixed: Extract or infer replay build/date information and stratify the cohort.
